resources.string: A Quick Note About Your Privacy

We use limited device and app information to keep QR Scanner fast, secure, and reliable, provide QR code scanning and generation features, show ads that help keep the app free, and improve your overall experience.
Your scanned content, personal files, photos, videos, and other private data are not collected for analytics or advertising and remain under your control.
⦿ Camera access - to scan QR codes and barcodes accurately and provide instant results.
⦿ App usage information - such as the scanning and QR generation features you use and screens you open - to improve app performance, stability, and user experience.
⦿ Device and app identifiers - to save your preferences, improve app stability, prevent errors, and support essential app functionality.
⦿ Advertising identifiers - to display and measure ads that help keep the app free.

By tapping Agree & Continue, you acknowledge our Privacy Policy. We use only the information necessary to provide QR code scanning, QR code generation, app security, and other essential features, improve the app, and support advertising. Your scanned content and private data remain under your control.

ScanPulse needs camera access to instantly scan QR codes, Wi-Fi credentials, and barcodes directly in real time.
Scans are processed completely on-device with zero server latency.
No video frames or raw captures are ever uploaded or cataloged.
Import photos directly from your library anytime without camera privileges.
